text: In accordance with Section 21 of the Rules of Procedure, the Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal has granted a request for review and has ordered a review hearing to hear appeal DDRT2022-08 in whole.

The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Confirmed the determination of a dangerous dog and directed that the conditions of the Order remain in effect, and that the Tribunal forward the reasons for this decision to Vince Ruffolo and the Executive Director, Municipal Licensing and Standards on or before April 19, 2023.
